notes: Read SKILL.md in full (single-file skill). Guides a blameless post-incident review per NIST SP 800-61 Rev 2 Section 3.4: timeline reconstruction, 5 Whys / fishbone root cause analysis, MTTD/MTTC/MTTR metrics, control-failure mapping, and a remediation plan in a fixed report format.

No commands, installs, credentials, or network access; allowed-tools is Read, Grep, Glob and the skill states it does not modify detection rules, deploy patches, or touch production systems (SKILL.md:443). It tells the agent to keep credentials and PII of affected individuals out of the report (SKILL.md:441).
